text:
maria: heads-up: private deploy in staging lost a bunch of KMS decrypt events after we rolled the stricter egress netpol. Services are falling back but audit counts dropped.

kevin: which namespace? i can jump in.

maria: redwood-keystore on staging. seeing connect timeouts to kms-ip:443 and TLS handshake errors from the egress-proxy.

olga: i pushed an RBAC change yesterday locking down keystore-proxy-sa perms (removed wildcard on some CRDs). could that cause suppression of audit forwarding?

maria: proxy logs show: "ERR dial tcp <kms-ip>:443: connect: connection timed out" and "WARN audit: suppressed decrypt for req=xyz". also node conntrack near capacity during rollout.

infra-bot: ALERT: metric(kms.decrypt.events) down 78% svc=keystore-staging (rule: kms-missing).

kevin: quick plan: 1) temp add netpol allow to kms-ip, 2) bump conntrack on staging hosts, 3) rotate ephemeral keystore after verification.

olga: RBAC likely not root cause but i'll keep revert ready.

maria: applying netpol allow now, will watch audit stream.

kevin: bumped conntrack via remote-run.

maria: decrypt events returning, sample: "INFO decrypt success req=xyz user=svc-model". good to rotate keys and then revert netpol and tune egress-proxy (keepalives/pool).

olga: noted. i'll add CRD-read resilience comments to PR #6124.

maria: filing INC-2026-staging-keystore, severity=P1. postmortem follow-up to analyze netpol rollout ordering and conntrack headroom.

kevin: thanks, keeping oncall updated.
